name: Breezy Bulldog 15
author: fcb4355
description: Outlined sky-blue button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes to #007ffe, text color changes from #222 to #fff, box-shadow becomes -20px 50px 50px #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Breezy Bulldog 15</title>
<style>
/* Breezy Bulldog 15 by fcb4355 — https://uiverse.io/fcb4355/breezy-bulldog-15 */
.button {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #bbb;
  color: #222;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55);
}

.button:hover {
  background-color: #007ffe;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: -20px 50px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border: none;
  padding: 10px 20px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
